takeaways: Canvas apps and Power Fx deliver fast results, but they hide complexity in dependency webs that become a maintenance problem once apps need integrations, source control and pipelines.

Power Apps code apps let developers build React and TypeScript apps in Visual Studio Code, deploy them with the Power Platform CLI and still inherit environment governance, connectors and Entra authentication.
Use low code for quick prototypes and departmental tools, move complex, long-lived systems to code apps, and let GitHub Copilot speed up both while reviews and testing keep the code correct.
hook: Low-code Power Apps made everyone a developer, and many enterprises now live with fragile canvas apps full of Power Fx formulas nobody can maintain. This episode helps Power Platform makers, pro developers and architects decide when to stay low code and when to move to code apps with React, the Power Platform CLI and GitHub Copilot.
